updates.background_zh: MiCA（《加密资产市场条例》，欧盟第2023/1114号条例）是欧盟针对加密资产的统一监管框架，涵盖代币发行、交易平台、托管与稳定币，取代了此前各国各自为政的监管格局。企业需在某一成员国取得加密资产服务提供商牌照，之后即可凭“通行证”在整个欧盟开展业务，因此选择哪个司法辖区申牌具有战略意义。法规设有过渡期，允许此前依据各国法律运营的企业暂时继续经营，这也正是待批申请的时间节点变得格外敏感的原因。
updates.background_en: MiCA (Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation, EU Regulation 2023/1114) is the EU's unified rulebook for crypto-assets, covering token issuance, trading venues, custody and stablecoins, and it replaced a patchwork of national regimes. Firms must be authorized as crypto-asset service providers in one member state, after which they can passport those rights across the EU, making the choice of licensing jurisdiction strategically important. A transition period allowed firms already operating under national law to continue temporarily, which is why the timing of pending applications became so sensitive.
updates.market_impact_zh: 该消息主要通过欧盟市场准入与流动性渠道传导至加密市场：若币安无法取得MiCA通行牌照，欧洲的现货与衍生品流动性可能向已获牌照的交易所和竞争对手迁移；同时报道中对美元稳定币的关注也波及MiCA框架下以欧元和美元计价的稳定币板块。此外，它还影响市场对其他交易所待批欧盟申请的预期情绪，因为这意味着政治考量可能凌驾于已完成的技术审查之上。
updates.market_impact_en: The story transmits to crypto markets mainly through EU market-access and liquidity channels: if Binance cannot secure a MiCA passport, European spot and derivatives liquidity could migrate toward already-licensed venues and competing exchanges, while the accompanying scrutiny of dollar stablecoins touches EUR- and USD-denominated stablecoin segments under MiCA. It also affects sentiment around other exchanges' pending EU applications, since it signals that political considerations can override an otherwise completed review.
